Reproduction Procedure: 1. Load PBIM project (528 nodes, 2063 edges). 2. Trigger dual snapshot diff against historical run. 3. Trace main JavaScript thread in browser.
Expected Result: Snapshot diffing computes asynchronously or in sliced micro-tasks yielding thread every 16ms.
Actual Result: Main thread executes synchronous map comparisons locking UI for 240ms to 350ms in browser DOM context.
User / Business Impact: UI freeze / unresponsive controls during comparative architectural review on large projects.
Recommended Fix: Slice diff computation into chunks with requestIdleCallback or setTimeout yielding.

Reproduction Procedure: 1. Load PBIM graph (528 nodes, 2063 edges). 2. Switch Cytoscape layout to hierarchical/dagre. 3. Measure UI thread duration.
Expected Result: Layout computes progressively with responsive spinner and non-blocking frames.
Actual Result: UI thread locks for 1.2s to 1.8s during synchronous Cytoscape layout.run() without yielding.
User / Business Impact: Perceived browser freeze and unresponsive canvas on large codebases.
Recommended Fix: Configure layout with animate: false for >300 nodes or offload to web worker; show spinner.

Reproduction Procedure: 1. Populate 100 historical analysis runs. 2. Invoke getAnalysisRuns(projectId, 100, 0). 3. Profile Apex CPU time.
Expected Result: Apex execution limits deltas or paginates to keep CPU usage <5% of 10s governor limit.
Actual Result: Synchronous loop over 100 records computing 3 mathematical deltas per record in Apex CPU.
User / Business Impact: Elevated Apex CPU consumption and timeout risk under heavy org concurrency.
Recommended Fix: Reduce DEFAULT_LIMIT to 20 and MAX_LIMIT to 50; require pagination.

Reproduction Procedure: 1. Rapidly adjust filter criteria sliders. 2. Observe JSON serialization calls.
Expected Result: Filter serialization and state dispatch debounced by 300ms.
Actual Result: Every slider input event triggers immediate JSON.stringify(activeCriteria) synchronously.
User / Business Impact: Micro-stutters and redundant serialization on rapid filter manipulation.
Recommended Fix: Add 300ms trailing debounce on filter serialization before emitting change events.

Reproduction Procedure: 1. Ingest synthetic 10 MB payload (10485760 UTF-16 code units). 2. Observe batch chunk consumption.
Expected Result: Payload chunks split deterministically across LongTextArea 131072 boundaries.
Actual Result: Reassembly loop in Node takes 0.017ms median but spikes to 12-65ms max under GC memory pressure.
User / Business Impact: Potential client-side memory spike during extreme 10MB payload reassembly.
Recommended Fix: Enforce streaming reassembly buffer and strict UTF-16 boundary checks.

Reproduction Procedure: 1. Open PBIM matrix view (528 nodes). 2. Profile matrix model construction.
Expected Result: Sparse representation scales O(N + E) without memory bloat.
Actual Result: Full NxN dense Uint8Array allocation requires 278784 bytes; sorting and edge mapping takes up to 15.7ms.
User / Business Impact: Noticeable pause when rendering dense matrix views on graphs >500 nodes.
Recommended Fix: Maintain sparse adjacency index instead of dense 2D allocation for matrix cells.
